runSummary.stalePolicy: LIVE eligibility requires real source verification and link evidence. Existing LIVE items are never removed merely because a discovery run does not rediscover them.
runSummary.note: Real 14.9.2026 20:20 sweep across 13 source families: Profesia, direct company careers/public ATS, LinkedIn public jobs indexing, Worki, Kariera/Zoznam, Brigada.sk, PracaZaRohom, Sluzby zamestnanosti, Pretlak/StartupJobs, Upwork/Freelancermap, Reddit/WordPress communities, WordPress Jobs public index and publicly indexed Facebook groups. Strongest new BA candidate is 3MON Office Manager/ka & Executive Support pre CEO: Bratislava, 1,650 EUR/month, e-shop order administration, customer communication, shipments, office/HR admin and AI tools. The language field is disjunctive: Slovak C2 OR English B2, therefore English B2 is not treated as an independent hard gate. Three years of related admin experience remains a fit penalty. Upwork surfaced a WooCommerce data-entry job at 35 USD fixed with 20-50 proposals; functionally relevant but below effective-pay/saturation threshold. LinkedIn surfaced Marlink Support Engineer at 1,700 EUR but B2 English and 24/7 three-shift NOC create a strong mismatch. Facebook produced 0 verified direct-post hits. No LIVE deletion was performed.

developmentChanges.title: Requirement disjunction parser
developmentChanges.reason: Parse OR/AND logic in job requirements instead of treating every listed language or qualification as mandatory. Example: Slovak C2 OR English B2 must not incorrectly become a B2-English hard rejection when Slovak C2 satisfies the stated alternative.

developmentChanges.title: Application effort vs fit score
developmentChanges.reason: Estimate response effort separately from role fit: CV language, custom assignment, cover letter, portfolio, platform credits and multi-stage application. Prioritize high-fit roles that can be answered quickly and avoid spending disproportionate time on low-probability applications.
